ns2:course.label: Teaching Elementary Science I
ns2:course.description: Course is the first of two, 3-hour science methods courses in the elementary education program, which will examine elementary science content, learning theory, and the teaching of science in the elementary school. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Admission to the Elementary Teacher Education Program.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Admission to the Elementary Teacher Education Program.
ns2:course.sectionCappArea: Restricted to Admitted Teacher Ed Student students.
